title: Topic 2: Personal Information - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Give name, age, nationality, phone, email; spell aloud

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. Give your personal information.
Say 4 things:
1. Your name (My name is...)
2. Your age (I am ... years old)
3. Your country or city (I am from...)
4. SPELL your first name (A - N - A ...)
Example: My name is Ana. I am 25 years old. I am from
Bertioga. A - N - A.

Tip: Practice the alphabet letters of YOUR name first.

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic02_personal_information.txt, Lesson 2.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.

criteria.title: Says name + age with I am
Says city/country with I am from
